theorems.name: Submission.p04_hca_bc7c754a4b_sum_equivariant
theorems.statement: ∀ {k G : Type _} [CommRing k] [Group G] (A B : Rep k G) (H : Subgroup G) [Fintype (G ⧸ H)] (F : Quiver.Hom (Rep.res H.subtype B) (Rep.res H.subtype A)) (g : G) (x : B), (∑ q : G ⧸ H, A.ρ q.out (F.hom (B.ρ q.out⁻¹ (B.ρ g x)))) = A.ρ g (∑ q : G ⧸ H, A.ρ q.out (F.hom (B.ρ q.out⁻¹ x)))
